messages:
Maya R: Quick design sync — playground streaming preview. Leaning toward a compact live preview pill + a clear interrupt affordance that works per-message. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE — please skim and flag major blockers.
Samir: Love the compact approach, but worried about discoverability and screen-reader behavior. How will SR users know there's live output vs final? :thinking:
Leah: Thought: make interrupt a per-message control (top-right of a message) with a visible focus ring and a tooltip. For SR add `aria-describedby` that explains state. Token counter — inline pill vs overlay? I prefer inline so it reads with the message context.
Devon: Perf note — client-side streaming currently updates DOM every chunk which causes caret jumps. We should debounce UI updates (e.g., 50–100ms batch) and only update visible token counter at a slower cadence.
Alex P: Copy nit: the button currently labeled "Stop" feels blunt. Options: "Pause generation", "Interrupt", "Cancel". "Pause" implies resume, which we don't support. Leaning to "Interrupt" with tooltip "Interrupt generation; partial output will remain." Also add `aria-label="Interrupt response generation"`.
Maya R: Agree on "Interrupt". Proposal: change label to "Interrupt", add short tooltip copy, and surface a small token pill in the message header (top-right). Token pill should be minimally intrusive and include `aria-hidden=false` so SR can read final token count but not every streaming delta.
Samir: For SR live updates, avoid using a generic `role=status` that announces every token. Instead, announce only state changes: "Generation started", and when complete fire a polite announcement: "Generation finished — 123 tokens". That keeps verbosity low.
Leah: Accessibility nit: current token pill contrast is ~3.8:1 on mock — needs >=4.5:1. Also keyboard focus state is missing on the interrupt icon; make it keyboard reachable (tab) and show visible outline. Add `aria-pressed` or `aria-checked` depending on interaction semantics.
Devon: I'll prototype a "smooth-update" debounce that batches chunks into 100ms windows and only mutates the DOM once per window. Also will wire the per-message interrupt to send a cancellation RPC that doesn't block other messages.
Alex P: UX addition: in the Prompt Library settings add a toggle: "Live preview while generating" (on/off). Some power users prefer to get final output only. Track that preference so we can default per-team.
Maya R: Good. Action items: @Leah can you run a quick a11y pass and list color/token contrast fixes? @Devon please build a prototype with 100ms batching + per-message interrupt. I'll update Figma and the copy strings (tooltip + aria-label). We'll reconvene for a 15-min sync tomorrow 11am PT. :thumbsup:
Leah: Will do. Quick mock notes: add keyboard shortcut hint on tooltip ("Esc — interrupt"), link `aria-describedby` from the interrupt to a short help doc in the console.
Samir: Analytics ask: capture `interrupt` events, `preview_enabled` toggle, and `tokens_final_count` as part of generation telemetry. Tag experiment group as `playground.livepreview.v1`.
Devon: On it — I'll also run a quick perf run with streaming enabled on low-bandwidth to measure perceived latency.
Maya R: Thanks all — I'll push updated screens by EOD and ping for a short follow-up. If you see any hard blockers in the figma link call them out inline.
